agent.finish_summary: Fixed MinIDMap.iteritems() in boltons/cacheutils.py to return (key, id) pairs instead of (key, weakref) pairs. The weakref objects were being yielded as the second tuple element, which caused TypeError when comparing/sorting with min()/sorted() since weakref.ReferenceType doesn't support '<'. Changed self.mapping[k][1] to self.mapping[k][0] to match the documented behavior (ID lookup) and the tuple layout established in get() (nxt, ref). Also removed a leftover debug print() statement in _clean(). Verified with a manual repro script that min()/sorted() over iteritems() now work correctly.
